AITA for saying I’d pay 100% up front and then backing out of it | I designed a product and I am in the process of reaching out to influencers to promote it. One of the influencers has asked me to pay 100% up front ($263 USD) right now. The only problem is, I’ve never met this guy. He’s an internet stranger who lives in Serbia and for all I know, he could steal my money and run.

Also, I made the mistake of paying an influencer $750, all in advance. He disappeared for a month and was unresponsive to my emails. It wasn’t until I threatened to sue him that he grudgingly responded and asked me why I’m so stressed out. He said he couldn’t respond because he’s too busy, but funny enough he was quick to respond before he got my money.

So I said to the Serbian influencer, I’ll pay you half up front and the other half after you post my links. He responds and says that “I’m not like other influencers” and he demanded the full payment right now. I hate arguments and I’m not a confrontational person, so I replied and said that I’d pay him the full amount in advance.

After thinking about it all night last night, I wrote an email to the Serbian influencer explaining the bad experience I had with the other influencer and how I wasn’t comfortable with paying 100% up front. He still hasn’t responded, but I’m sure he’ll be super angry to find out that I backed out of my word.

So AITA?

AITA for killing my friend’s pet spider and refusing to pay for it? | My friend Megan (20F) is letting me crash at her place for the next few days. I got into a huge fight with my fiancé and got kicked out. I am extremely grateful that Megan is letting me stay with her while I figure things out with my fiancé and get back on my feet.

This morning I wanted to invite Megan out to lunch as a thank you. I went into her room to ask her and saw a huge ass spider on her bed just chilling. I screamed so loud I’m surprised I didn’t shatter every glass within a 10 mile radius and immediately grabbed the nearest object to kill it.

And then I squished it.

Megan ran out of the bathroom when I screamed and saw what happened. To my surprise she started crying! Apparently she had the spider out so she could clean its enclosure and it was her pet. It was also a very rare and exotic species that cost her a lot of money (hundreds of dollars).

She is extremely upset with me and is asking me to pay her for the spider. I am refusing because I feel like 1) there was NO way I could’ve know this was her pet and I had a normal human reaction and 2) she left her spider just chilling there and that’s on her.

She is pissed off and probably going to kick me out but I feel justified in my stance. AITA?

My boyfriends daughter (19) has enrolled in drivers ed to learn how to drive she has to document over 40 hours of driving. The last time I took her out driving she had nearly caused multiple car accidents from not listing/paying attention to the road.
She will run red lights, cross in to other lanes without looking, and has often shifted in the wrong gear (such as drive when trying to reverse or reversed when trying to drive)

AITA for going after a girl who rejected me until the point where the school intervened? | So, throwaway for obvious reasons.

This story consists of two people, me, and this girl. I need to get it straight that I loved her _a lot_. Like, I would have married her if we were older and going out. At the time I didn't regret any of this.

So it was the day before Valentine's Day and I plucked up the courage to ask her out. She tells me no but that I'm really sweet and that she's sorry it's how she feels. She also added that if I gave her a few months, "maybe" she'd develop feelings for me.

About a month later, I'm still madly in love with this girl and decide to try again. I wrote a song about her and sent it to her,  which she said she really liked so I got more hopeful. I wrote another one (looking back the lyrics are quite cringy) and sent it. She liked it and said no one had said things so nice about her. She was really keeping my hopes up (and we did flirt a bit anyway) but still doesn't like me.

Around another month later I write a letter straight from my heart to her about how I really feel. This letter contains some pretty deep stuff, and I make sure to put it in an envelope and pit "READ WHEN ALONE" on it. Her being stupid she opens it and reads it while in a lesson at school when her friends are around her. The rest of the class hear (because she's reading it out loud) and eventually the teacher catches on and goes to one of the heads of year because they're concerned (she actually texted me later saying the letter was sweet but she already knew my feelings for her and didn't need the letter).

The school then starts an investigation and talk to the girl and she tells them about me asking her out and writing the songs (I think she told them about everything because we had a falling out a few days before). They decide that I've don't something really wrong. They make me go to see a doctor to talk about the situation (or else they'd bring someone in to talk to me). I get a day in insolation (in a room for the whole day in silence doing work) and the news spreads and people gossip about it for the next few months.

Basically, my friends all think this is creepy but I say I was just doing it out of true love and that they don't know what it feels like. Bare in mind I have come to kind of regret it now. I didn't intend on anything bad happening and I'd really like some opinions.

AITA for deleting other people’s social media accounts? | I have two separate email addresses: one with my real name (for work stuff), and one with a nickname for family, friends, and my own social media stuff.

Someone signed up for Instagram using my “work stuff” email. I left a comment (using their account) on one of their photos: “If you’re reading this, it’s because you signed up for the account using my email address. You should change it to your true email address, otherwise I’m shutting this down.” I gave them almost two weeks, during which they changed their password (I had reset it to leave the message), posted more content, but didn’t update the address. I proceeded to close the account. She reopened it. I closed it, and then opened my own account so that this wouldn’t happen again.

AITA?
